original.statement: The `experimental.ruler.enable-api` configuration option is removed in Loki 3.0.0; users must migrate to `ruler.enable-api` instead.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the `experimental.ruler.enable-api` option; use `ruler.enable-api` instead. Exposed: Loki workloads that still pass the -experimental.ruler.enable-api flag. Workloads passing -ruler.enable-api instead appear safe.

decision.reason: [ev-8fea3a0e7308] names only the dotted, hyphenated `experimental.ruler.enable-api` (replaced by `ruler.enable-api`) under "Deprecated configuration options are removed". In the same section that naming style is used for Loki CLI flags ([ev-03b4fbe630df], [ev-f5a61f629314], [ev-f15092605ae3]), not Helm values paths, so a values-key leaf reads the wrong source. Exposure should test whether the removed flag is still passed, with the replacement flag as overlap. Confidence is low because the item never literally says "CLI flag" and the dash prefix is assumed.
